subject: skill/stack/neo4j-cypher
claim: Anchor Cypher MATCH patterns on labels and typed, directed relationships, and attach WHERE to the MATCH it refines — predicates are part of the pattern, not a post-filter. Pass values as parameters ($title) rather than string-concatenating them; the manual notes that dynamic labels/types $() likewise mitigate Cypher injection. Carry variables deliberately across clause boundaries with WITH, because a variable that is neither referenced nor explicitly imported is discarded before the next clause. Prefer static labels/types over dynamic ones, which have documented planner/index caveats.
notes: The MATCH page backs WHERE-with-MATCH semantics, parameter usage, WITH variable scope/carry-over, dynamic labels and types with the injection-mitigation note, and the per-version planner/index performance caveats. The Introduction backs Cypher as a declarative property-graph language and the Cypher 25 vs frozen Cypher 5 version split (relevant to any newer syntax). Moderate uncertainty because the Introduction fetched mostly as navigational prose.
